title: Official 2025 BMW BERLIN-MARATHON GPX (BM25_Marathon-Strecke)
claims: SCC Events' official domain still serves a marathon GPX named BM25_Marathon-Strecke.gpx; a HEAD request on 2026-11-21 returned HTTP 200, application/octet-stream and 24,110 bytes.
The file is GPX 1.1 with creator 'SCC KML/KMZ/GPX Tools'; it contains 508 trackpoints, no waypoints, no <ele> elements, and no track name, description or timestamp.
A local haversine measurement of the 508 trackpoints gives 42.1836 km, 0.0114 km (11.4 m, 0.027%) shorter than the official 42.195 km.
The first trackpoint is 52.515214 N / 13.360200 E and the last is 52.516013 N / 13.372547 E; the coordinate bounding box is 52.467576–52.529712 N and 13.281231–13.428996 E.

Because the file carries no elevation values, it cannot support a climb, descent or high-point calculation; the page's 73 m gain and 79 m descent remain the separate Abbott World Marathon Majors figures.
The file has no copyright line and no redistribution licence; it is linked only and is not copied into the site, bundled or redrawn.
